svg.aria-label: Each project's share of downloads on versions older than its fixed reference release, in three weeks
svg.text: Share of downloads on older versions, three weeks running
Each row is one project; older means below its reference release R0, held fixed (the release of 21 August 2026 or earlier).
Grey band: within 5 points of 21 to 27 September, the brief's test. Projects whose dots leave the band are named in bold.
